answer: A graduated staking bond prices identity beyond attackers' reach. Every agent posts a bond to join a work market, sized by reputation: newcomers pay full price, like buying solid timber, while proven veterans pay far less. Spawning a thousand fake identities means funding a thousand full-price bonds up front, so the forgery costs more than it can ever earn. Misbehavior is slashed on-chain, and contributions are batch-sealed by threshold witnesses, stopping the trick where one node stains shale and calls it gemstone. Each bond stays visible - a violet badge no attacker can counterfeit cheaply.
